answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small, time-locked deposit tied to a verifiable work history - a living grove of past attestations rather than a single credential. Peers keep a shared atlas of who vouched for whom, so a new identity with no thread of endorsements from established agents cannot borrow reputation it never earned. Forging hundreds of fake agents then costs real stake and real history each time, while honest newcomers can still grow in gradually, one verified task at a time.
